title: Meet Marisol
body: Marisol handles state incident reporting for five senior living communities. Here is her morning before and after this tool.

title: Every incident, one view
body: All open and recent incident reports across every community, with the time left before each filing deadline.

title: Full incident history
body: Every care note, message and form change for an incident, in one timeline.

title: A gap, caught early
body: This fall report is missing the physician notification time. The tracker flagged it as soon as the draft was checked, not hours later.

title: The clock is visible
body: A live countdown to the filing deadline. No more tracking it in a spreadsheet.

title: Marisol still decides
body: Nothing goes to the state until Marisol reviews the draft and clicks approve herself.

title: The numbers that matter
body: Open reports, on-time filings, hours to file and open exceptions, all computed from the incident data.

title: How this would be built
body: Incident data would come from Aline Care into Power Automate flows, with Teams approvals, Dataverse for tracking, and Azure OpenAI drafting inside the group's own Microsoft tenant.
